_comment: Flat MILP AllGather on mini_2gpu_1nic with switch copy. 4 hosts x 2 NVLink-bridged GPUs behind ONE shared 100Gbps NIC on a PCIe root complex, 2 leaves / 2 spines. Flat only: the root complex cannot be a cell (see its .topo). CAUTION: a flat solve has one switch_copy for every switch, and the root complex is a self-routing (non-programmable) switch, so a copy there is not realizable as a switch entry. Measured 2026-10-18: the solve copies at the root complex (switch 9) and ncclize refuses ('flow 1 ... branches at switch 9, which takes no forwarding program'). Realizing this sample needs the flat MILP to copy only at programmable switches (not implemented). switch_copy true: every switch may copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port. Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK epoch; objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first. Output: Schedules/<name>.json. See teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
